Independent of A-F - its own position, never conflict-closed, skipped on Wednesday/calendar days or if rule C already opened today · AW) NEW 9 Nov 2026, 2022-heavy - Wednesday re-entry: only on rule A's own signal days; if price closes back through the 14:00 price within 30 min AGAINST rule A's direction -> a 2nd trade IN rule A's direction, stop 2.0x the range, exit 21:30 broker · K2) NEW 9 Nov 2026, 2022-heavy - K+ add-on at HALF size: only after a K+ trade; if price runs a further 0.5x the range beyond K+'s own trigger price in the same direction as the original stretch -> a 2nd fade, same direction as K+, HALF the normal size, stop 2.0x the range, exit 21:30 broker (not K+'s own 19:00).
